html:
SMTO-SKL-0063 — This email attachment is too large

GUID: 08e3cbd8-6e8a-5ef9-be0c-8a18dfdd4ddc
Slug: microsoft365-attachment-too-large
Domain: SKL · Subsystem: microsoft365

What happened

  • Emails sent through SMTO can carry up to about 3 MB of attachments in total, and SMTO can download email attachments up to about 25 MB. This one is over the limit, so it wasn't sent or saved.

How to fix — simple steps

  1. For an email you're sending, remove some attachments or use smaller versions so they add up to less than 3 MB. SMTO checks the total size of all attachments before sending and stops when it's over 3 MB.
  2. For a big file, ask SMTO to upload it to your OneDrive and put the link in the email instead. A link has no size limit in the email, while the file itself stays in OneDrive.
  3. For an attachment you're trying to download that is over 25 MB, open the email in Outlook and save the attachment from there. SMTO won't download email attachments larger than 25 MB.

What success looks like

  • SMTO confirms the email or draft with its attachments, or the downloaded attachment appears under Artifacts.

If it still fails

  • Select Copy error details and send them to the person who manages SMTO.

Technical details

Observed condition

  • Outgoing Microsoft 365 mail attachments exceeded 3 MiB in total, or a mail attachment download exceeded the 25 MiB limit.

What this means

  • Mail attachment preparation exceeds 3 MiB total, or attachment metadata/streaming exceeds its download byte bound. This explanation performs no Microsoft request. The original operation stage and receipt determine its effect; keep the selected tenant, account and resource identity fixed during recovery.

Why this can happen

  • Mail attachment preparation exceeds 3 MiB total, or attachment metadata/streaming exceeds its download byte bound.

How to diagnose it

  • Distinguish the outgoing aggregate bound from the attachment download bound.

How to fix it

  • files.attachments limits outgoing attachments to 3 MiB in total for mail_send and mail_create_draft, and to 3 MiB for the single file in mail_attachment_add. mail_download_attachment refuses attachments over 25 MiB. Share larger content through a OneDrive upload (files_write) and a link, or save it directly from Outlook.
  • Reduce outgoing mail attachments to 3 MiB total or downloads to 25 MiB; use a separately authorized cloud-file workflow for larger content.

Retry and execution caution

  • Inspect provider state and exact account authority first.

How to verify the fix

  • Intended attachments fit their operation-specific limits and complete normally.

What not to do

  • Do not expose secrets or blindly replay uncertain mutations.

Technical notes

  • This explanation performs no Microsoft request. The original operation stage and receipt determine its effect; keep the selected tenant, account and resource identity fixed during recovery.
  • Preserve the occurrence ID and safe request/operation references. Receipts and occurrence facts establish what started or completed; the catalog does not authorize retries or establish execution outcome.
